display.summary: The hand-off to Composer works: an inline update now actually reaches it, and the run it hands over is finished from Composer's acknowledgement instead of staying open for ever.
highlights: “Started apply request” no longer ends in “'DluxUpdateRun' object has no attribute 'control_operation_id'” — the request is written and Composer picks it up.
The Options card reports the result: applied, rolled back, or needing an operator, with the versions refreshed.
A handed-off run can no longer wedge the deployment: it ends, and the next update can be queued.
